
## Stations database example 
```{r , echo=FALSE}

mystns=system.file("extdata/stations.csv", package = "brdstns")
mystat<-stns_db(mystns)
knitr::kable(mystat)

```


## Parameter list for stations routines called
*The example below results from calling 'stns_plst_set("Munn","pi",2026,9)'*

```{r , echo=FALSE}
myparms<-stns_plst_set("Munn","pi",2026,9)
str(myparms)
```
